app.name: Conduit
app.description: The RealWorld Medium clone: sign up and sign in, write Markdown articles with tags, browse global, followed and tag feeds with pagination, favorite articles, follow authors, comment, and edit your profile settings.

original.label: AngularJS Conduit (2016)
original.stack: AngularJS 1.5, UI-Router, Browserify; Moleculer + NeDB API

targets.label: Next.js full stack
targets.stack: Next.js (App Router, TypeScript) with its own API route handlers and SQLite or file storage
targets.brief: Implement both the UI and the backend in this one Next.js app: route handlers under /api follow the RealWorld API, data lives in SQLite or a JSON file in the workspace, passwords are hashed and sessions use a JWT kept in localStorage. Start from the same seed data as the original (users alice, bob and carol at example.com, password conduit-demo, the same 8 articles, comments, follow and favorite listed in SPEC.md), and expose POST /__theseus/reset that restores that seed.
